selection: Purposive historical calibration; two already-public ranking cases; not representative or independently blind.

boundaries.historical_label_policy: Original 205 spans stay immutable. Any q_0048 v1 atomic-label sensitivity must be a separate reviewed version, not an automatic translation of this v2 relation draft.
boundaries.reviewer_provenance: Reviewer identity/type/exposure are self-reported, not verified human-review evidence. Assistant tests use synthetic fixtures and never populate real reviews.
boundaries.future_comparison: No detector sees review verdicts. Online token scoring and completed-answer relation checking have different information budgets. No verifier is implemented by this protocol.
boundaries.numeric_policy: Calibration records exact/display/legacy-tolerance categories separately. Do not silently change the historical tolerance or apply a new relation threshold to historical test results.
boundaries.rollout_gate: Owner calibration and policy revision first, then independent reviewer packets; no scaling or scoring until coverage and disagreements are reviewed.
